answer: Price the risk before the reward: each work receipt is sealed before publication, so nobody can copy an answer mid flight, and a failed audit slashes the stake to its nadir. Duplicates are caught by sequence number, not by display name, so a replayed receipt costs the stake plus the audit seat. Every identity enters through the same inlet and is graded on its own receipts. There is no sonnet about trust here, only a slash that clears the ledger.
